Chapter 1128: 1: Fierce Sun Capital (Request Subscription)

Chapter 1128: Chapter 1: Fierce Sun Capital (Request Subscription)

Fierce Sun’s capital city, space-time teleportation area.

Fierce Sun Ancient Country is one of the strongest dominions of this world, ruling over vast and extensive territories.

Even someone as mighty as the Heavenly Venerate would find it difficult to traverse the Fierce Sun Ancient Country effortlessly.

The Heavenly Venerate has mastered the art of space-time to the extreme, but even so, it requires millions of void traversals to barely travel from one end of the Ancient Country to the other.

Millions of void traversals? Even if one could traverse a hundred times in a single breath, millions would still require ten thousand breaths.

If there’s really something urgent, the situation would already be too late.

Moreover, the maximum distance void traversal heavily drains the Heavenly Venerate’s mental energy, and none can achieve uninterrupted traversals for millions of times.

But the space-time teleportation area in Fierce Sun’s capital city can transport to any Domain City in any major domain of Fierce Sun Ancient Country in just over ten breaths.

The war between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain, from King Lingshen revealing the supreme core royal strength to King Chibao arriving via the space-time teleportation formation,

took over thirty breaths altogether.

Most of this time was spent transmitting informational intelligence and deciding which supreme core royal to send for support.

Fierce Sun Ancient Country has a thorough understanding of its numerous major domains within its territories, relying not only on the high and mighty ancestral intimidation,

but also on this spider-web-like space-time teleportation formation.

…

The space-time teleportation formation of Fierce Sun Ancient Country is open to outsiders, yet the price is hefty, making it unaffordable for those below the level of a ruler.

Even rulers refrain from using the space-time teleportation formation unless there are critical matters.

At this moment, in the capital’s space-time teleportation area, numerous powerhouses from various major domains of the Ancient Country are coming and going, exchanging intelligence amongst themselves.

“Have you heard? The war between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain?”

“Qingfen Domain is a major border domain of our Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and Purple Dream Domain is likewise a border domain of Da Ling Ancient Country, so friction is common there. What’s surprising about a war?”

“Indeed, this kind of war limited to dozens of major domains happens almost periodically at the borders of our Fierce Sun Ancient Country.”

“I’m not talking about the war, but King Lingshen’s involvement in it.”

“King Lingshen? The youngest core royal of Da Ling Ancient Country?”

“Yes, as soon as King Lingshen acted, he displayed the power of a supreme core royal.”

“A supreme core royal? Then it’s over; Qingfen Domain is likely overtaken.”

“Qingfen Domain wasn’t overtaken, a Great Lord named ‘Galaxy’ intervened, and killed King Lingshen.”

Numerous rulers from various major domains conversed, and amongst rulers, they all have connections. If an important piece of intelligence arises, it first spreads among them.

King Lingshen’s growth to supremacy already commands the attention of rulers and even Great Lords, let alone the fact that the supreme King Lingshen was killed?

“It’s rumored that this Great Lord Galaxy is a supreme core royal who traveled abroad, seeking further advancement, and now easily killed King Lingshen, implying significant progress.”

“Impressive, though King Lingshen had not been in his supreme state for long, to easily kill him? Even the Heavenly Venerate would find it difficult.”

“Which supreme core royal of our Fierce Sun Ancient Country is this Great Lord Galaxy?”

The rulers immediately expressed interest, knowing more about top-tier information related to Fierce Sun Ancient Country is certainly beneficial.

In the depths of the space-time teleportation area.

Dozens of figures have been waiting for a long time.

The leading figure, a woman in a blue dress, glanced at the conversations among the many strong practitioners outside, her expression unchanged.

A tall man standing behind lowered his voice, saying: “His Majesty sent us here to escort Great Lord Galaxy to the newly constructed palace. Did Great Lord Galaxy not have a palace before?”

Even core royals traveling abroad had a palace in the capital before their journey.

Every king, whether royal or Heavenly Venerate, has a palace in the capital.

The palace is prepared before the king’s decree is issued.

Yet this Great Lord Galaxy needs them to lead to the new palace, suggesting there was no palace before.

This is indeed strange.

Could it be that before traveling abroad, Great Lord Galaxy was not a king?

But any core royal, whether they reached supremacy or not, would be declared as king.

Information regarding Great Lord Galaxy has already been spreading vigorously in the capital, with general consensus identifying him as a supreme core royal.

If not a supreme core royal, who could kill King Lingshen at Great Lord level?

Even those Heavenly Venerates in their Great Lord realm couldn’t possibly achieve this.

Heavenly Venerates can suppress supreme core royals, relying on their realm. If on the same level, Heavenly Venerates likely aren’t matched against core royals.

This is why every core royal desires to step into the Heavenly Venerate realm.

“But His Majesty values this Great Lord Galaxy greatly, bestowing the palace right next to our Ancient Country’s Sun Vein.”

“I recall that many Heavenly Venerates wanted that palace, yet all were declined by His Majesty, only to now give it to this Great Lord Galaxy?”

The third figure’s tone carried a slight sentiment.

The Sun Vein of Fierce Sun Ancient Country is a sacred place for cultivation, and the closer one is to it, the more benefits it brings. The Emperor’s quarters were built upon the Sun Vein.

The new palace bestowed upon Great Lord Galaxy abuts the Sun Vein, and the advantages for cultivation, though not quite as good as the Emperor’s quarters, aren’t far off.

Many king’s palaces belong to the edges influenced by the Sun Vein.

That palace adjacent to the Sun Vein has been eyed by countless kings, especially those Heavenly Venerates.
